name: co_star_real_estate_scraper
description: Scrapes publicly accessible pages from CoStar News GB and extracts article, property, and market signals when available.
capabilities: Collect sale, acquisition, financing, refinancing and letting stories.
Monitor public news about developers, landlords, investors, occupiers and agents.
Build commercial real estate research datasets from public CoStar articles.
Export extracted property, transaction, media and company data to BI tools, CRMs, spreadsheets, dashboards or enrichment pipelines.
Automate recurring monitoring of new CoStar property news for market monitoring, lead generation, investment research and deal tracking.

inputs.name: startUrls
inputs.description: Public CoStar listing or section pages to seed the crawl.

inputs.name: maxItems
inputs.description: Maximum number of records to store in the dataset.

inputs.name: maxRequestsPerCrawl
inputs.description: Requested cap for total requests, including listing and detail pages. In filtered modes the actor may raise the effective cap so maxItems can be reached.

inputs.name: maxConcurrency
inputs.description: Maximum number of pages processed in parallel.

inputs.name: desiredConcurrency
inputs.description: Preferred steady-state parallelism target for the crawler.

inputs.name: maxPaginationPages
inputs.description: Requested number of listing pages to follow from seeded sections. In filtered modes the actor may raise the effective value so enough strict records can be found.

inputs.name: includeArticleBody
inputs.description: Store the full cleaned article text when available.

inputs.name: includeHtml
inputs.description: Include raw article HTML in the dataset. This increases output size.

inputs.name: compactOutput
inputs.description: Remove null, empty, and static compatibility placeholder fields from dataset items. Disable only if you need the full compatibility schema.

inputs.name: onlyPropertyArticles
inputs.description: Skip generic newsroom articles that do not contain property-specific signals such as addresses, companies, prices, areas, or property types.

inputs.name: onlyUkArticles
inputs.description: Skip non-UK or globally focused articles when running against the CoStar GB news feed.

inputs.name: strictStoryMode
inputs.description: Keep only transaction, development, financing, sale, and letting stories. Drop people-moves, commentary, and broader market-analysis articles.

inputs.name: requireAddress
inputs.description: Skip otherwise valid records when no property address is exposed in the public article metadata.

inputs.name: includeFailedRecords
inputs.description: Store blocked or failed requests in the dataset. Disabled by default so output contains only successfully extracted records.

inputs.name: searchTerms
inputs.description: Optional terms used to add matchedSearchTerms to records that mention specific markets, tenants, or property types.

inputs.name: proxyConfiguration
inputs.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Recommended if CoStar blocks your requests.

inputs.name: proxyInitializationTimeoutSecs
inputs.description: Maximum seconds to wait while initializing proxy access before failing or falling back to direct connection.

inputs.name: fallbackToNoProxyOnProxyError
inputs.description: If enabled, the Actor continues without proxy when proxy initialization fails or times out. Disable this when proxy usage is mandatory.
